description: Exterior view of house at Ghost Ranch, courtyard; O'Keeffe sits on the ground at the corner of the portal  looking at the camera dressed in black wearing black cap-like hood; animal bones and horns (including a backbone) are scattered in the foreground - viewer right, nine animal skulls are impaled on poles at the end of the portal, a kiva log ladder leans against a section of the portal with its numerous protruding vigas; the portal and O'Keeffe are in partial shadow
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
